newsitem.title: USA: World Bank approves 160 mln mark loan for Croatia.
newsitem.headline: World Bank approves 160 mln mark loan for Croatia.

text.p: The World Bank said on Tuesday it approved a 160 million mark loan for Croatia to help it restructure and privatize state-owned banks and enterprises.
The loan will help to speed up private sector development and further promote Croatia's integration into European financial markets, the Bank said in a statement.
The interest rate on the loan will be based on the London Interbank Offered Rate (LIBOR). The loan will have a maturity of up to 15 years and be disbursed into two equal tranches.
